purpose: Teach: 夕刻/論外/切り出し/有償/ジョイント/レパートリー/字体/期生

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、夕刻の会議で本日のまとめをしろ
lines.en: At the evening meeting, I want a summary of today's developments.
lines.style: Clear, measured directive. Clipped consonants. No room for questions—this is instruction, not discussion. Lean forward slightly on the verb.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。価格交渉での要求は論外です
lines.en: Yes. The price negotiation demands are completely off the table.
lines.style: Respectful but assured. Moderate pace, steady eye contact. Confidence in the judgment, not defensiveness. Speak to the merit of the decision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新事業の話を切り出して反応を見ろ
lines.en: When you bring up the new business, watch their reaction closely.
lines.style: Tactical, deliberate. Slight weight on 'watch'—this is the point. Lower volume, like sharing strategic intelligence. Patient pause after.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。有償サポートのプランを準備しました
lines.en: Yes. I've prepared the paid support tier options.
lines.style: Prompt and competent. Quick attack on the opening word. Factual delivery, no elaboration—let the work speak. Professional momentum.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、他社とのジョイントベンチャーを検討しろ
lines.en: Have the new joint venture framework explored by end of week.
lines.style: Directive with underlying weight. Not rushed. Each clause lands. Expectation of execution, not discussion. Slight emphasis on 'framework'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人のレパートリーが広がってきました
lines.en: Yes. The new staff are already taking on a wider range of projects.
lines.style: Engaged but restrained. Slight warmth on 'wider'—this is good news delivered professionally. No overstatement. Steady, reassuring cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ロゴの字体を新しくしろ
lines.en: Update the company logo typeface. I want options by Friday.
lines.style: Businesslike, unhurried. Clear priority signal. Not a favor to ask—a task to execute. Straightforward tone, no softening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人期生の歓迎会を計画しております
lines.en: Yes. We're organizing a welcome gathering for the new cohort.
lines.style: Warm professionalism closing the exchange. Slightly lighter tone than before—this is a positive note. Respectful but personable. Clean finish.
